name: dianne-place-recovery-services

scripts.build: npm run content:generate-backlog && npm run content:self-produce && npm run release:state && npm run content:build-admin-manifest && npm run content:build-answers && npm run seo:build-sitemap && npm run seo:site-css && next build

scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:hard && npm run validate:demand-backed-pages
scripts.validate:release: npm run content:generate-backlog && npm run content:self-produce && npm run release:state && npm run content:build-admin-manifest && npm run content:build-answers && npm run seo:build-sitemap && npm run release:daily-proof && npm run release:self-heal && npm run validate:all
scripts.validate:authority-modernization: npm run validate:protected-client-core && npm run validate:authority-distribution && npm run validate:post-2026-continuity
